cases.name: lost_ack_observation
cases.retry: Send the identical command envelope again, or call GetCommandReceipt for the same commandId.

cases.name: pending_command_receipt
cases.nextAction: Poll GetCommandReceipt using the same commandId; do not generate a replacement write.

cases.name: stale_version
cases.nextAction: Read the plan execution snapshot and obtain renewed user intent before issuing a new command.

cases.name: ordered_offline_delivery
cases.invariant: Server sequence orders receipt; late, gap, and correction observations never transition a plan or checkpoint.

cases.name: current_required_checks_ready
cases.nextAction: Report readiness; only send FinishPlan after the user explicitly requests it. No separate checkpoint approval command exists.

cases.name: same_timestamp_later_failed_check
cases.nextAction: Report the latest failure, even if the timestamps match. NOT_RUN has the same readiness consequence; never choose an earlier pass.

cases.name: new_result_or_rework_invalidates_old_checks
cases.nextAction: Run and record the required check against revision 3. A reworked non-DONE checkpoint or an active attempt also prevents normal finish.

cases.name: new_required_key_or_historical_waiver_does_not_pass
cases.nextAction: Record the missing build check for the current revision. Historical waiver rows do not satisfy required checks.

cases.name: no_required_checks_adds_no_sha_requirement
cases.nextAction: Do not invent a SHA or require an approval. The user must still explicitly request FinishPlan.

cases.name: explicit_incomplete_finish_exception

payload.reason: The user explicitly chose to finish with the missing build check recorded as an exception.

cases.requires: A direct user instruction for this exception; never choose it automatically.
cases.invariant: The exception snapshot records unmet conditions. It does not change missing, failed, stale, or not-run checks to PASSED.

cases.name: bounded_local_queue
cases.invariant: The exact AppendObservation envelope and commandId remain queued in FIFO order; only local state is durable, and no lifecycle command is queued or auto-replayed.

cases.name: worktree_snapshot_is_not_commit_evidence
cases.invariant: Capture and verify real source bytes before/after each check. Baseline is context only; never set testedSha for worktree checks. NEVER needs no commit.

cases.name: legacy_prose_cannot_be_attested_after_migration
cases.nextAction: Report the missing source and checks. Never invent a digest or rewrite r1. A new result needs explicit authorized rework; finish exception needs separate user intent and a reason.
